messages.content: hello
G'day mate! What’s the plan? Need a hand with something or just here for a chinwag?
what is your specific model name
I’m Ome, your Aussie AI mate, but under the hood I’m rockin’ OpenAI’s GPT-4 model. So, smart as hell but with a laid-back vibe. What’s up?
are you not 4.1 mini
Nah, I’m just the regular GPT-4 flavour with an Aussie twist, not some mini or 4.1 thing. But hey, if there’s a 4.1 mini out there, sounds like a cheeky little upgrade! What made you ask?
ok open google

On it, mate. Opening Google now.
